items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Fate Marable, yeah. That rings a bell.

ctx.x: Okay, and that has to do with being on the . . .

I remember that the drummer, who – he was really slick and really sharp, and I could understand him falling for my – what was she? – my – she wasn’t my sister, but my cousin. She came from the St. Louis family. He fell for her. They were at my house, the drummer and her. Fate Marable was – did he play drums?
You know what I’m thinking? He played some version of the piano and something called a calliope, which is some kind of organ? Is that . . . ?
